title: UneceVoucher
description:
A printed piece of paper or an electronic document that can be used instead of money to pay for an experience, such as a
tour, a trip or a meal in a restaurant.

applicableIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this experience item voucher is applicable.

description.description: A textual description of this experience item voucher.

faceAmount.description: A monetary value shown on the face of this experience item voucher.

identifier.description: The identifier for this experience item voucher.

issueDateTime.description: The date or date time of the issuance of this experience item voucher.

issuingCompanyName.description: A name, expressed as text, of the company issuing this experience item voucher.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of experience item voucher.
